messages:
samira: Quick thought  want to do a low-key 'Improv & Tacos' night Wed Jul 30 @ 7pm in the lounge. Short improv prompts (no experience needed) + taco bar. RSVP with :taco: to come, :raised_hands: to help run prompts.
tony: :taco: In. Can help with sound/phones for virtual folks.
jade: :raised_hands: Ill run a few warm-ups and a 'yes, and' exercise.
omar: :taco: Probably a bit late (daycare pickup) but will join after 8pm if that's okay.
kelly: Remote that week but would love to join virtually for some rounds. Zoom?
samira: Yup I'll post a Zoom link. Quick poll: prize for "most ridiculous scene"? React :trophy: = yes, :shrug: = nah.
tony: :trophy:
jade: :trophy:
omar: :shrug: (let the chaos win)
samira: Prize it is (tiny rubber chicken). @facilities-bot can you reserve the lounge and set up folding chairs + a whiteboard for Wed Jul 30 6:30pm for setup?
facilities-bot: Event created: "Improv & Tacos"  Wed Jul 30  7:00 PM  Lounge  RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/event/imp123 (setup 6:30 PM)
tonY: Also, dietary needs? I can order tacos with veggie + GF tortillas.
jade: Vegetarian here  thanks for asking.
omar: GF please for me.
samira: Noted  I'll place a mixed order. If building rules stop food, fallback is improv-only and BYO snacks. Please RSVP by Mon Jul 28 if you want tacos.
kelly: I'll RSVP remote. Zoom link pls.
samira: Thanks! Volunteers: prompts = jade, sound = tony, setup = omar + facilities. I'll post Zoom + order link on Monday and a reminder Tue evening. Super casual  bring a friend if theyre visiting campus. :taco: :microphone: :chicken:
